(Currently Amended) Claim 21: The airfoil according to claim 20, wherein the leading edge sweep angle at the 0% span position and a leading edge sweep angle at the 100% span position are positive and the leading edge sweep angle at the 100% span position is less positive than a leading edge sweep angle at about a 70% span position.

(Currently Amended) Claim 25: The airfoil according to claim 1, wherein the airfoil is a fan blade for a gas turbine engine, and the fan blade includes leading edge and trailing edge sweep angles that maintain a positive relationship within specified span positions as defined in the claims. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 26: A gas turbine engine comprising: a combustor section arranged between a compressor section and a turbine section; a fan section having an array of twenty-six or fewer fan blades, wherein the fan section has a low fan pressure ratio of less than 1.55; a geared architecture coupling the fan section to the turbine section or the compressor section; and wherein the fan blades include an airfoil having pressure and suction sides, the airfoil extends in a radial direction from a 0% span position at an inner flow path location to a 100% span position at an airfoil tip, wherein the airfoil has a curve corresponding to a relationship between a trailing edge sweep angle and a span position, wherein the trailing edge sweep angle is in a range of 100 to 200 and varies from a minimum positive angle to a maximum positive angle over the entirety of the span positions. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 27: A gas turbine engine comprising: a combustor section arranged between a compressor section and a turbine section; a fan section that has a low fan pressure ratio of less than 1.55; and wherein the fan blades include an airfoil having pressure and suction sides, the airfoil extends in a radial direction from a 0% span position at an inner flow path location to a 100% span position at an airfoil tip, wherein the airfoil has a curve corresponding to a relationship between a trailing edge sweep angle and a span position, wherein the trailing edge sweep angle is in a range of 100 to 200 and is defined across the specified span positions to ensure optimal aerodynamics.

(Currently Amended) Claim 28: The gas turbine engine according to claim 27, wherein the low fan pressure ratio is less than 1.52 but does not exceed 1.55.

(Currently Amended) Claim 29: The gas turbine engine according to claim 28, wherein the low fan pressure ratio is less than 1.50.

(Currently Amended) Claim 30: The gas turbine engine according to claim 29, wherein the low fan pressure ratio is less than 1.48.
